milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_wood with an axe drops the dark_oak_wood item into the player's inventory. The player starts with an iron_axe and there are 6 dark_oak_wood blocks at ~4-5, y=0-3, z=3. The item is not in the starting inventory (only light_gray_dye, shears, and iron_axe are given).

Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_fence with an axe drops the dark_oak_fence item into the player's inventory. There are 4 dark_oak_fence blocks forming a barrier line at ~6, y=0, z=2-5. The item is not in the starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining birch_trapdoor with an axe drops the birch_trapdoor item into the player's inventory. There are 2 birch_trapdoor blocks on the birch hut walls at ~9, y=1, z=2 and z=5. The item is not in the starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a light_gray_bed places it into the player's inventory. The player crafts it at the crafting table (~5, y=0, z=9) using 3 light_gray_wool (from shearing the 3 NoAI light gray sheep in the pen) and 3 dark_oak_planks (crafted from mined dark_oak_wood). The item is not in the starting inventory.
